about: Possible finding: the record holds no line about why Nuelin SR was supplied and shows no companion respiratory treatment.
The record gives asthma as the reason for theophylline and shows no companion respiratory supply within 60 days of any Nuelin SR supply.
Nuelin SR (theophylline) is supplied monthly but Symbicort (budesonide with formoterol, an inhaled preventer) is supplied on the same days, so theophylline is not used alone.
